# 00000005237

**MS3-07 ◆** — source: 160_代数几何V_模空间.md

**English.** Definition: The tautological ring is the cohomology subring generated by special classes. Conjecture: The table of quadratic relations of the tautological ideal is always complete within genus six, and the table dimension is given by the rank formula of graph counting. (graph-rank table of tautological quadratic relations)

**中文。** 定义：重言环指由特殊类生成的上同调子环。猜想：重言理想的二次关系表在亏格六以内恒完全；且表维数由图计数的秩公式给出。（重言二次关系图秩表）
